theorems.name: Submission.dorag_haa_weakly_harmonic_limit
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (R : ℝ) (u : ℕ → Euclid n → ℝ) (c δ : ℕ → ℝ) (W : Euclid n → ℝ), (∀ j, ∃ L : NNReal, LipschitzWith L (u j)) → Tendsto δ atTop (𝓝 0) → MemLp W 2 (volume.restrict (ball (0 : Euclid n) R)) → Tendsto (fun j => ∫ x in ball (0 : Euclid n) R, (u j x - c j - W x) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0) → (∀ (j : ℕ) (ζ : Euclid n → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ ball (0 : Euclid n) R → ∀ G : ℝ, (∀ v, ‖fderiv ℝ ζ v‖ ≤ G) → |∫ v in ball (0 : Euclid n) R, ∑ i : Fin n, fderiv ℝ (u j) v (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) * fderiv ℝ ζ v (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))| ≤ δ j * G) → ∀ ζ : Euclid n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 2 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ ball (0 : Euclid n) R → ∫ y in ball (0 : Euclid n) R, W y * ∑ i : Fin n, iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 ζ y ![EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ), EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)] = 0
